risks.risk: The console is not a standard Xbox model, but a custom build, which may not be functional or may have hidden damage.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the console's model number or serial number, and a video showing the console powering on and running a game.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a non-functional or non-standard console, which is significantly lower than a standard Xbox.

risks.risk: The 1TB storage claim is unverified; the console may not have the advertised storage capacity.
risks.proof: A photo of the console's system settings screen showing the storage capacity, or a video of the console booting up and showing the storage status.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having unknown or lower storage capacity, which reduces value.

risks.risk: The controller may be non-functional or have internal damage, especially since it is a custom build.
risks.proof: A video showing the controller connecting to the console and responding to inputs.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a non-functional controller, which reduces value.

risks.risk: The console may be missing essential components such as the power cable, HDMI cable, or disc drive.
risks.proof: A photo showing all included accessories laid out, including the power cable and any cables.
risks.if_unproven: priced as missing accessories, which reduces value.

proof_requests: Photo of the console's model number or serial number.
Video of the console powering on and running a game.
Photo of the console's system settings screen showing storage capacity.
Video of the controller connecting to the console and responding to inputs.
Photo showing all included accessories (power cable, HDMI cable, etc.).
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
